prompt: Phone plan A costs $\$12$ plus $\$0.10$ per minute. Plan B costs $\$0.30$ per minute with no base fee. Solve $12 + 0.10m = 0.30m$ to find the number of minutes $m$ where the plans cost the same. Give just the number.
hint: Get the $m$'s on one team: subtract $0.10m$ from both sides.

hints.text: Get the $m$'s on one team: subtract $0.10m$ from both sides.

explanation: Check: plan A costs $12 + 0.10(60) = \$18$; plan B costs $0.30(60) = \$18$. ✓ Same price at 60 minutes.

alternativeExplanations.title: Race with a head start
steps: Plan B charges 20 cents more per minute, but plan A starts $\$12$ ahead.
B catches up 20 cents each minute. To close a $\$12$ gap takes $1200 \div 20 = 60$ minutes.
